platform.tagline: Secure, fair and transparent online assessments

about.title: About SAPM
about.intro: SAPM is the secure assessment engine of ShyamPracticePaper (SPP). It conducts proctored online exams — communication, aptitude and technical rounds — so you can practise under real placement conditions.
points: Runs fully in your browser. No software installation is required.
Checks your system, camera and microphone before the test begins.
Verifies your identity so every candidate competes fairly.
Records and transcribes your spoken answers during communication rounds.
Scores speaking accuracy, pace and clarity with our own speech engine.
Shows your complete report — recordings, transcripts and improvement tips — right after you submit.
about.note: SAPM is built and operated entirely by ShyamPracticePaper. No third-party proctoring service is involved, and your monitoring data never leaves our servers.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: We collect only what a fair, proctored assessment needs — nothing more. This notice explains what we collect, why, and your rights.

groups.heading: What we collect
points: Your name and email, from your ShyamPracticePaper account.
Webcam snapshots during the test, to confirm the right candidate is appearing.
Voice recordings and transcripts, to score your answers and build your report.
Your submitted answers and timing information.
Basic device checks (camera, microphone, browser) before the test starts.

groups.heading: How we use it
points: Only for assessment integrity, scoring and your improvement report.
Never for advertising, profiling or resale. We do not sell or share your data.
Recordings and reports are visible only to you and authorised SPP administrators.

groups.heading: Retention and deletion
points: Recordings, snapshots and proctoring logs are deleted automatically soon after your result window closes.
Scores and attempt summaries are kept so your progress history stays available.
Deleting your ShyamPracticePaper account permanently removes your personal data.

groups.heading: Security and payments
points: Data is stored on ShyamPracticePaper servers and protected with access controls.
Your session is guarded by a secure, single-use test token.
Payments are processed by Razorpay; card details never touch our servers.

groups.heading: Your rights
points: See your own recordings, transcripts and scores in your report after each test.
Request a copy or correction of your data from your registered email.
Delete your account — and your data — anytime from your profile page.

privacy.note: If anything here is unclear, or you want to exercise any right, write to us before your next assessment — we reply from a human, not a bot.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By starting an SAPM assessment you agree to the following rules.
points: Only the registered candidate may take the test. Impersonation ends the session immediately.
One test window at a time. Multiple windows, devices or tab switching invalidates the session.
Camera and microphone access is required for proctored rounds and must stay on.
Each test can be submitted once. Results are available for a limited time after submission.
Questions, passages and test recordings are the property of ShyamPracticePaper and must not be copied or shared.
terms.note: These terms may be updated as the platform evolves. The version on this page is always the current one.

cookies.title: Manage Cookies
cookies.intro: SAPM uses exactly one cookie — a strictly necessary session cookie from ShyamPracticePaper.
points: It keeps you signed in and protects your test with a secure session token.
It prevents your exam from being opened in two places at once.
It is HttpOnly — scripts on the page cannot read it — and expires when your session ends.
No advertising, analytics or third-party tracking cookies are set.
cookies.note: You can clear this cookie anytime by signing out or clearing your browser data for this site — you will simply need to sign in again. During payment, Razorpay may set its own cookies on its checkout page under its own policy.
